mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits catecholamine metabolism, increasing norepinephrine levels which can cause hypertensive crisis when combined with propranolol's beta-blockade, creating unopposed alpha-adrenergic effects and potential cardiac complications.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use with extreme caution under close cardiac monitoring with blood pressure checks and consider alternative antidepressants with safer cardiac profiles.
